sections.A: Pasliyan peeche reedh se aur aage seene ki haddi se cartilage ke zariye juri hain. Dard dono siroon par ho sakta hai: rib dysfunction, costochondritis ya fracture.
sections.B: Ek jagah tez dard jo dabane par wapas aata hai, gehri saans, khansi, chheenk ya mudne par barhta hai, aur mehnat ya bukhar se juda nahi.
sections.C: Chot ya girna, mehnat par dard, saans phoolna, khoon wali khansi aur bukhar ke baare mein zaroor poochein.
sections.D: Seene ke dard mein pehle vital signs. Phir dekhein, har jor aur pasli dabayein, aur saans par dard check karein.
sections.E: Jor dabana, pasliyon ko aage-peeche aur side se dabana, aur hooking test dard ki jagah dhoondte hain.
sections.F: Dil ka attack, phephron ka collapse, pneumonia aur fracture ko pehle rule out karein.
sections.G: Paseene aur baazu ya jabre tak dard, chot ke baad achanak saans ki takleef, ya kai pasliyon ka fracture: emergency.
sections.H: Seene ka dard ho to pehle dil aur saans ki wajah dekhein, phir fracture. Ek jagah ka dard jo dabane par aaye aur koi doosri wajah na ho to musculoskeletal.
sections.I: Costochondritis ka asal ilaaj samjhana hai, yeh bezarar hai aur hafton mein theek hota hai. Fracture mein saans ki exercise zaroori hai.
sections.L: Gehri saans par dard, dabane par dard aur kaam ki salahiyat track karein. Fracture aam taur par 6 hafte mein judta hai.
sections.N: Sawaal hal karein. Yaad rakhein: sirf dabane par dard costochondritis sabit nahi karta; pehle dil ki wajah rule out karein.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
